# Task 24: 사원 관리 Frontend 구현

Created: 2026-10-05T23:48:34+00:00
Vikunja identity: instance=db1048c53fd44194aedc6863ebaca313 project=19 task=24

## Goal

Provide the employee-facing web interface for the employee CRUD service and connect it to the backend REST API.

## Scope

- React UI in a dedicated `frontend/` component.
- Employee list with employee number, name, department, position, email, phone, and hire date.
- Create and edit form with required-field and email-format feedback.
- Delete confirmation and readable API/validation errors.
- API integration for list, read, create, update, and delete operations.

- Keep frontend source and package configuration separate from the Express backend.
- Follow the API contract in the parent plan; do not create a separate frontend-only data store.
- Do not add authentication, roles, payroll, org chart, or bulk import.
- Worker allocation: Codex, model `gpt-6-luna`, reasoning effort `low`.

- [ ] The UI lists employee records and provides create, edit, and delete flows.
- [ ] Required-field and API errors are visible and understandable.
- [ ] The UI uses the backend API for all employee data changes.
- [ ] The frontend production build succeeds.

## Verification plan

Build the frontend with its production build command and review the changed UI/API integration code. Handrail check IDs are recorded in `.handrail/specs.json`.

# Task 25: 사원 관리 Backend API 구현

Created: 2026-10-05T23:50:03+00:00
Vikunja identity: instance=db1048c53fd44194aedc6863ebaca313 project=20 task=25

## Goal

Provide the Express REST API and persistent storage for employee CRUD operations.

## Scope

- Express backend in a dedicated `backend/` component.
- SQLite schema and persistence for employee number, name, department, position, email, phone, and hire date.
- Endpoints: `GET /api/employees`, `GET /api/employees/:id`, `POST /api/employees`, `PUT /api/employees/:id`, and `DELETE /api/employees/:id`.
- Validate required employee number and name, unique employee number, and email format when supplied.
- Return consistent 400, 404, and 409 errors for invalid input, missing records, and duplicate employee numbers.

## Constraints

- Use Express and SQLite; records must survive backend restarts.
- Keep backend source and package configuration separate from the frontend.
- Do not add authentication, roles, payroll, org chart, or bulk import.
- Do not commit credentials or local database files.
- Worker allocation: Cursor, model Grok 4.7. The effort variant will be set from the user's choice before assignment.

## Completion criteria

- [ ] All five employee CRUD endpoints operate on SQLite-backed records.
- [ ] Required-field, email-format, missing-record, and duplicate-number cases return the specified error classes.
- [ ] Employee records remain after restarting the backend.
- [ ] Backend JavaScript syntax check succeeds.

## Verification plan

Run `node --check` on the backend entry point and review the route, validation, and SQLite persistence implementation. Handrail check IDs are recorded in `.handrail/specs.json`.


Report changed files, checks run, and any unresolved issues. Stay within the approved scope.

  되는지까지는 실행해 보지 못했어.

  프론트랑 맞출 때 가정

  • 생성은 201, 목록·조회·수정은 200, 삭제는 본문 없는 204야. PUT은 부분 수정이 아니라 필드를 통째로 다시 써.
  • 기본 포트는 3001이고, 로컬 프론트에서 부를 수 있게 CORS는 열어 뒀어. 입사일 형식은 따로 검사하지 않아.
